name: Mr. Rowe
role: Cattleman of Rowe, Parker & Easton; Billings County commissioner
bio: Mr. Rowe of Rowe, Parker & Easton was listed among the cattlemen in April 1885 and proposed for county commissioner in October 1885. In December 1886 the paper urged him, as the third commissioner, to qualify at once.

moments.label: Urged to qualify as third commissioner

mentions: …at the meeting yesterday. Among them we noticed H. S. Boice, Geo. Towers, Pierre Wibaux, Griffin & Ward, Mr. Rowe, J. N. Simpson and all the stockmen tributary to Medora.

…io. No justice of the peace has as yet qualified and the terms of the old ones expire Jan. 1. It behooves Mr. Rowe, the third commissioner, to qualify at once and rescue us from our present "slough of despond."
